---
description: "Instructions to use whenever creating or editing assignment markdown files to ensure consistency and clarity for students."
applyTo: "assignments/**/*.md"
---
# Assignment Markdown Structure Guidelines

Use [the assignment template](../../templates/assignment-template.md) for each assignment README.md. Retain the title, objective, tasks, description and requirements, including the template icons. State a short learning objective, use action-oriented task names and clear student-friendly descriptions. List measurable requirements as bullets and provide examples only when helpful. Preserve existing learning outcomes when reformatting. Do not add unrelated sections or full solutions.
